# LAW Electrics

LAW Electrics is a Manchester-based electrician serving domestic and commercial customers across Greater Manchester.

## Contact
- Phone: +44 7849 971457
- Email: Lukewooly12@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/law_electrics/
- General opening hours: 07:00–22:00 daily
- Emergency call-outs are available by phone.

## Services
- Lighting and electrical fittings
- Sockets and switches
- Fault finding and repairs
- New domestic and commercial electrical installations
- Outdoor and security lighting

## Main areas served
Manchester, Salford, Walkden, Bolton, Wigan and Bury. Customers in nearby Greater Manchester areas can call to check availability.

## Quotes
Free, no-obligation quotes are available by phone or text. The on-page job selector is informational and does not transmit personal data.
